I say that, although these rebellious States are in, territorially, the Union, and cannot get out by any act of theirs, yet by their rebellion they have forfeited their right to representation in the Halls of Con- gress, and placed themselves where the na- tional Government can determine at will when thoy shall resume again their original positions and have a^voice in the legislative halls of the nation.
